name: hydroqc2mqtt
description: This project was created to provide a way to access Hydro-Québec account and winter credit data in Home-Assistant. This module use the hydroqc library to fetch all pertinent account information and winter credit signals to be sent to MQTT. It also provide Home-Assistant discovery topics to create all the relevant sensors in Home-Assistant. It also includes a separate logic that sends the hourly consumption statistics to Home-Assitant via websocket

variables.name: Contract 0 Name
variables.description: Name of the contract, will appear in Home Assistant and in the hydroqc topics.

variables.name: Contract 0 Customer number
variables.description: Customer number (Numéro de client) from your invoice. 10 digits, you may need to add a leading 0 to the value Ex: ‘987 654 321’ will be ‘0987654321’

variables.name: Contract 0 Account Number
variables.description: Account Number (Numéro de compte) from your invoice

variables.name: Contract 0 Contract number
variables.description: Contract Number (Numéro de contrat) from your invoice. 10 digits, you may need to add a leading 0 to the value. Ex: ‘123 456 789’ will be ‘0123456789’

variables.name: Contract 0 Homeassistant websocket URL
variables.description: URL to your Home-Assistant installation websocket API

variables.name: Contract 0 Homeassistant Token
variables.description: Long-lived Home-Assistant access token to be used to access the API

variables.name: Contract 0 Hourly sync consumption Flag
variables.description: Enable importing hourly consumption from Hydro-Quebec (last 24h)

variables.name: Contract 0 Rate Option
variables.description: Rate option for the contract must be 'NONE' if you do not have one.

variables.name: Contract 0 Preheat duration
variables.description: Duration of the pre-heat period in minute
